title: Incident (v1)
description: Canonical incident envelope (SPEC-015 R-1). incident-service builds one envelope per normalized alert group (Alertmanager webhook) or manual operator report and stores/serves it verbatim. fingerprint is the dedupe key: the Alertmanager groupKey (or a stable hash of the label set) for alertmanager incidents, a 'manual:' marker for manual reports. status advances new -> triaging -> triaged | triage_failed; resolved is terminal for the intake lifecycle. triage_raw preserves the raw agent reply only when triage fails validation, so operators can inspect what went wrong. session_id names the dedicated agent session carrying the triage conversation (incident-<incident_id>, or incident-<incident_id>--<operator> when a second operator re-triages).

incident_id.description: Globally unique incident id assigned by incident-service.

fingerprint.description: Dedupe key: Alertmanager groupKey (or hash of the label set) for webhook incidents; 'manual:' marker for manual reports.

source.description: Intake channel that created the incident.

severity.description: Normalized severity; webhook intake maps the Alertmanager severity label, defaulting to warning.

title.description: Short human-readable title (alert summary annotation or operator-provided).

summary.description: Incident description (alert description annotation or operator-provided).

labels.description: Normalized label map (Alertmanager commonLabels or operator-provided).

reported_by.description: Operator name for manual incidents; absent for webhook intake.

session_id.description: Dedicated agent session (incident-<incident_id>) once triage has run; absent before first triage.

triage_raw.description: Raw agent reply preserved when triage failed validation; absent otherwise.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339) of the last status or report change.

resolved_at.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339) when the incident was resolved; absent otherwise.
